title: Secret Objective Progress
description: Your own secret objectives now show how far along you are, like the public objectives do: have / threshold, what counts, and a bar (green once met). Shown on the player sheet's private hand and in the Objectives dialog (which now lists your secrets outside the scoring window too). Secrets met by an event (Prove Endurance, Destroy Their Greatest Ship, ...) get a note instead of a bar. Mocked fixtures; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CN.

notes.title: Where the numbers come from
notes.text: The server adds secret_objective_progress to the viewing seat's own PlayerView, computed by ti4_engine::secrets::progress: the same counting helpers the secret requirements use (counting_progress and remaining_position_progress), so a full bar means the card is legal to score, timing aside. Display-only: not in canonical() or the fingerprint; no rule or option id changed.

notes.title: Privacy
notes.text: Computed only for ViewerRole::Player(seat) and only for that seat's own hand, from that seat's redacted state. Opponents and spectators get no field at all, even for secrets Search Warrant turned face up; covered by projection_redaction.rs. The checked-in actor/opponent/spectator fixtures are unchanged.

notes.title: Coverage
notes.text: 27 of the 40 secrets have a count: ctr, eap, fwm, gamf, faa, mrm, mp, mlp, mtm, otf, csl, dhw, fsn, sb, lsc, te, fc, dfat, btgk, ans, dp, syc, pem, sai, ose, eh, hrm (lsc, te and fc need the map). The 13 event secrets (baf, bam, btv, dtd, dtgs, dts, dyp, fwp, mew, pe, sar, ttfd, uf) have no running count and show a note.
